text:
maria-ops: quick follow-up from the postmortem: pulling remediation items into a short sprint for the DR game day. please add ETAs here. main areas: multi-region routing flaps, restore runbook gaps, snapshot verification failures.

aj-sre: ack. I'll own A1 (routing policy + DNS TTL checks). Plan: patch canary in eu-west Tues, roll Wed. ETA Wed EOD.

samir-ml: noted recurring KV rebuild storms after failovers. Proposing TTL alignment + jitter + pre-warmers. Draft RFC up later today.

dee-eng: A2 (backup validation): found S3 lifecycle tag mismatch in us-east. revalidation Thu, add automated smoke restore if green. ETA Fri.

karen-platform: runbook edits (A3) started, PR incoming. adding manual cutover checklist, DNS expectations, and optional BGP prep. Need infra reviewer. @aj-sre can you review?

aj-sre: will review PR. prefer to keep BGP prep optional for game day with clear warning about propagation.

maria-ops: agree, optional + callout "expect longer DNS propagation if skipped".

samir-ml: RFC link (draft): https://internal.docs/ttl-jitter. TL;DR: increase TTL 30->90s, add +-20s jitter, warm caches pre-failover.

opsbot: Reminder: game day scheduled 2024-11-12 15:00 UTC. Channels: #game-day #oncall. Runbook version: v2.1.

dee-eng: blocker: need temp access to validation cluster to run smoke restore. @karen-platform can you grant until Fri?

karen-platform: granted temporary role to dee-eng until Fri. also added IAM checklist item to runbook.

maria-ops: action matrix paste: A1: routing failover policy 1 owner aj-sre 1 patch & canary Tue -> roll Wed; A2: backup validation + smoke restore owner dee-eng revalidation Thu -> smoke Fri; A3: restore runbook edits owner karen-platform PR -> review today -> merge by Thu; A4: cache TTL alignment owner samir-ml RFC today -> rollout next week.

aj-sre: FYI: canary logs show intermittent 502 on region-egress path, tagging infra-network. snippet: ```[2024-11-05T09:14:02Z] route-egress: 502 upstream_timeout region=us-east-1```

dee-eng: adding a restore checklist entry for network-specific 502 fallback procedures.

maria-ops: let's reconvene Fri 16:00 UTC for status huddle. update ETAs here by EOD Thu if anything changes. thanks :thumbsup:

samir-ml: updated ETA in thread, trying to get TTL change into staging for tests.

karen-platform: PR merged after @aj-sre review. merged commit 7a2c9d. runbook bumped to v2.2.

opsbot: Note: runbook v2.2 deployed to internal wiki.

maria-ops: TODO: during game day capture one-line regressions and playbook feedback; I'll compile into follow-up doc.

aj-sre: :thumbsup:

dee-eng: smoke restore logs will be uploaded to /backups/smoke-logs/3345678901

maria-ops: closing thread for now. reopen if slips. last reminder: ETAs by EOD Thu; check-in Fri 16:00 UTC.
